data.one_liner: Dart types and helpers for Cucumber message protocol (NDJSON).
data.what_it_does: Provides generated Dart classes for all Cucumber message schemas. Includes utilities for reading and writing NDJSON streams, timestamps, and durations.
use_when: You need to exchange Cucumber messages between processes in Dart/Flutter
You want strongly‑typed access to Cucumber JSON schema data
You need NDJSON stream support for test results
avoid_when: You only need simple JSON parsing without generated models
You are not using Cucumber or BDD testing
strengths: Fully generated from official Cucumber JSON schemas
Supports NDJSON streaming out of the box
weaknesses: No runtime features beyond generated models
No built‑in test runner or BDD framework

alternatives.name: json_annotation
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer manual JSON serialization with annotations instead of generated schema types
